Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to pick what to front-load for next sprint: eval-triggered alerts or quantization recommendations. Customers are asking for both; we should decide which to prioritize and what the MVP looks like.

Sam (Eng): My gut: alerts are higher customer urgency but touch infra & routing. Quant recs are more self-contained in the optimizer service.

Maria (ML Eng): Alerts also need reliable eval signals. If we ship alerts too early, we risk noisy noise and alert fatigue. Need baseline eval datasets and mapping to regression metrics.

Toby (CS): AcmeHealth and BetaCorp both flagged regressions as top risk — they asked for automated evals->alerts. They want a <3% drop alerting threshold, with rollback/playbook.

Anya (PM): Proposal: ship a scoped eval-triggered-alerts MVP first with narrow coverage (text-generation models, top-3 customers), then follow with quant recommendations in next slice. Acceptance criteria:
- can detect regression on provided eval set within 15m of ingest
- alert created in console + email + webhook
- false positive rate <= 10% on holdout evals
- rollback playbook documented (steps + owner)

Sam (Eng): From infra side rough work:
- collector + pipeline (kinesis -> eval service) — 3 dev days
- alerting rules engine + webhook support — 4 dev days
- console UI hook + permission checks — 3 dev days
- canary routing + rate limits — 2 dev days
Estimate = ~12 dev days for scoped MVP (single region).

Maria (ML Eng): For signal quality we need:
- eval set canonicalization + hashing (so we can dedupe)
- basic metric suite: BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-concordance/qual heuristics
- simple thresholding + historical smoothing (EWMA)
I can produce the baseline scripts in ~5 days and initial thresholds if we have 500 eval samples per customer.

Toby (CS): Can we promise rollout to 3 customers for pilot? AcmeHealth ok to be first if we give control plane visibility and a rollback path. They want weekly sync.

Anya (PM): Rollout plan (canary):
1) Internal dogfood (1 week)
2) 1 external pilot (AcmeHealth) with manual ack flow (2 weeks)
3) Gradual ramp to 5 customers (2–4 weeks)

Anya (PM): Minimal UI/UX for MVP:
- alert feed in console with model/version + metric + delta
- per-alert actions: acknowledge, mute, trigger rollback
- link to failing eval examples
This can be a shallow UI (table + modal).

Sam (Eng): Ops note — need an SLA for eval ingestion latency. If we target "detect within 15m" that constrains batch sizes and function timeouts. Also add a circuit-breaker to stop spamming on noisy signals.

Maria (ML Eng): Target metrics for thresholds:
- sensitivity: catch >70% of real regressions in our historical set
- specificity: keep FPR <10%
We should include a tolerance for seasonal/noise shifts and ability to tune per-customer.

Toby (CS): Comms ask: we need a standard incident/alert template for customers. Example fields: model, version, metric, delta, top failing prompts, recommended action, contact. I can draft it.

Anya (PM): Quick sample webhook payload we can use for implementation:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "acme-123",
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "version": "2026-03-01",
  "metric": "embedding_concordance",
  "baseline": "0.87",
  "current": "0.81",
  "delta": "-0.06",
  "threshold": "-0.03"
}
```

Sam (Eng): Nice. For the rollback action we should wire a test-only API + permission gate so we can run dry-runs. Also add a throttled retry for webhooks.

Maria (ML Eng): For quant recommendations: we can run the recommender offline during the alerts pilot and ship as "beta recs" (non-blocking). That reduces risk and gives data to tune quant policies.

Anya (PM): Decision: prioritize eval-triggered alerts MVP this sprint with scope: text-gen models, single region, 1 pilot customer, minimal UI, webhook + console feed, rollback doc. Quant recs will be collected offline and scoped for following sprint as "beta recs".

Anya (PM): Action items: @Sam create infra RFC + task list (due EOD Fri), @Maria produce baseline eval scripts + threshold proposals (due Wed), @Toby draft customer comms + playbook (due Thu). I'll own rollout plan and acceptance criteria.

ops-bot: Reminder — create incident channel #pilot-acme-alerts when pilot starts.

Sam (Eng): I'll post the RFC in #eng-runtime and link here.

Toby (CS): I'll ping AcmeHealth and schedule weekly check-ins.

Maria (ML Eng): Starting eval data prep today. will post progress.

Anya (PM): Thanks team — going to lock the ticket and update roadmap. :white_check_mark:
